description.ja: マッシブなプロポーションに豊富な武装が付属する大ボリュームなセットでULTRAMAN SUIT JACKが登場！
description.en: ULTRAMAN SUIT JACK is now available as a large volume set with massive proportions and a wealth of weapons!

description.ja: -ACTION-仕様ならではの躍動感あふれる自然なポージングも実現！
description.en: -ACTION- Specification allows for dynamic and natural poses!

description.ja: ■ビーム兵器を再現する光線エフェクトが付属。
description.en: • Comes with a ray effect to recreate beam weapons.

description.ja: ■清水栄一先生描き下ろしデザインのオリジナル武装が付属！
description.en: • Original weapons designed by Eiichi Shimizu are included!

description.ja: ■本体をはるかに上回るサイズ約265mmのアックスが付属。
description.en: • Comes with an axe that is approximately 265mm in size, much larger than the main body.

description.ja: ■腕部に装備したレールガンとソードはパーツ差替えにより再現可能。
description.en: • The rail gun and sword equipped on the arm can be reproduced by replacing parts.

description.ja: ■-ACTION-仕様ならではのパーツ分割により躍動感がありながら、自然なポージングを再現。
description.en: • -ACTION- The parts are divided into parts to create a dynamic and natural pose.

description.ja: ■腹部関節は「可動優先時」と「LEDユニット(別売り)内蔵時」2パターンの選択式。
description.en: • The abdominal joint can be selected from two patterns: ``when movable is prioritized'' and ``when the LED unit (sold separately) is built in''.
